result.brief: 提出注视感知的分层框架，先推断意图并定位接触，再用扩散模型联合生成6-DoF物体轨迹与双手关节运动，并构建阶段化自我中心HOI预测基准。
result.reason: Egocentric hand-object interaction forecasting with diffusion-based future motion generation and gaze-modulated VLM visual representations; contributes to embodied world modeling and future prediction.
